messages:
Alex G: Quick FYI — planning a canary for EU edge routing at 21:00 UTC tonight. Target is to shift 10% of user traffic to the new edge pool (eu-edge-v2) for 30m. No infra changes, just routing weights. Will run smoke checks and then increment if stable.

Maria T: Who's driving the deploy? I can be on standby for rollback.

Alex G: I'm kicking off the weight change. Jamal will handle monitoring and rollback steps. Maria — thanks, please be ready 20:45 UTC.

Kai L: Can you confirm the exact command you'll use to adjust weights? Also want the list of smoke checks so I can add quick alerts to the dashboard.

Alex G: Using RouteManager API: ```POST /v1/routing/weights {"region":"eu","from":"eu-edge-v1","to":"eu-edge-v2","weight":0.10}``` We'll run checks: 1) 200 responses for /health on eu-edge-v2 2) p50/p95 latency for text-gen route stays within 10% 3) no increase in 5xx on origin.

Jamal R: I'll watch metrics. My plan: baseline snapshots at 20:50, apply canary at 21:00, check after 5m/15m/30m. If errors > 0.5% or latency degradation > 15% we roll back immediately.

Syd P: Add synthetic canary traffic too — I'll run the traffic generator against a few customer-like prompts during the 5m check. Posting the command: ```./canary-run --region eu --profile customer-sim --qps 10 --duration 300```

Maria T: Rollback procedure?

Alex G: Rollback is just re-sending weights back to eu-edge-v1 (100%) and clearing eu-edge-v2 to 0. I'll run it and ping here. Jamal — do you want me to wait for your explicit :thumbsup:?

Jamal R: Please wait for my OK. I'll post status at 21:05 with the first quick pass. If I post :rotating_light: we rollback.

OpsBot: Deploy window created by Alex G — start=1769991600 end=1769993400, change_type=routing-weight-shift, target=eu-edge-v2, canary=10%

Kai L: Dashboard alerts I added: EU TextGen p95 anomaly, EU 5xx rate, KV cache miss rate. Also hooked a PagerDuty run for oncall.sea.

Alex G: Thanks. Plan summary: 20:45 standby, 20:50 baseline, 21:00 apply 10% to eu-edge-v2, checks at +5/+15/+30, rollback criteria as above. Communication: Jamal posts status updates here. If green at 30m, we'll schedule 50% bump tomorrow morning.

Syd P: I'll leave a console session open and dump logs to #incidents if anything odd shows up. :eyes:

Maria T: Oncall is aware. I'll be reachable via DMs and can run the rollback if Alex is tied up.

Jamal R: 20:58 — baseline snapshots complete. Metrics look nominal.

Alex G: 21:00 — applying 10% to eu-edge-v2 now.

OpsBot: Change applied by Alex G at 1769991660 — eu-edge-v2 weight=10%

Jamal R: 21:05 — first check: health endpoints OK, p95 +3%, 5xx 0.12% (baseline 0.08%). Keeping eyes on it.

Syd P: Synthetic run returned expected responses, no obvious correctness regressions.

Kai L: Seeing slight uptick in cold-start latency for some models on v2; p95 still within the 10% threshold.

Maria T: Noting this. No rollback yet.

Jamal R: 21:20 — second check: p95 +5%, 5xx steady 0.15%. Still under our rollback threshold.

Alex G: Good. Holding for the 30m mark. If we stay stable, we'll consider increasing to 25% tomorrow.

Jamal R: 21:30 — final canary check: p95 +4%, 5xx 0.14%. Canary looks healthy. Marking as GREEN. :white_check_mark:

Alex G: Thanks everyone. I'll open a follow-up PR to schedule the 50% bump and include lessons (cold-starts observed). Closing this thread for the canary — leaving notes in the deployment runbook.

Maria T: Nice work.

Syd P: :tada:
